notes: A bounded official-API translation of the native-green 102-assertion HLA_EVOKED matrix. With undefined Query GALT, the adapter FOM selects enabled or disabled Non Regulated Grant. Each run checks both empty and queued timestamped-interaction FQR cases. The grant's actual time, optimistic logical time, callback order, and post-grant Query Logical Time are observed through public APIs. The installed-package C++ primary and contract first passed focused CTest in HLA_EVOKED, then passed eight direct runs spanning both callback models and both adapter FOM switch settings (out/mgw/fqr-undefined-galt-nrg-both-models-{enabled,disabled}-20261021.json). Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR and passed four focused provider runs across the same callback/FOM matrix. The page-202 l107-29 candidate is crosswalked to the §8.13 Flush Queue Grant result under RL-349, not the erroneously exported §8.13.3 preconditions. The original native matrix remains evoked-only; other transport topologies, other providers, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
